whatsNew: The Android app now uses the website's normal mobile responsive layout instead of the previous fixed/desktop-style WebView presentation.
The Android WebView is set to 85% scale so the website fits the phone screen correctly.
Typing in login, betting and other input fields no longer automatically zooms the WebView.
The update popup now fills the screen instead of appearing as a small centered card.
The update popup text and buttons are enlarged for much better readability on mobile screens.
The What's New section now lists the actual changes included in the released version.
The Download Latest Update button is handled by the native Android updater rather than relying on the browser/WebView.
The downloaded APK is validated before Android is asked to install it, including checking that it is a valid newer E-Football Competition Bet build.
The app checks for available updates repeatedly while the app is open so a triggered release can be detected without waiting for a manual refresh.
The current app version is shown at the bottom-right of the website footer after the Contact section and is read from the current release version.
The footer version updates automatically for future releases instead of requiring the version text to be changed manually on every page.
